categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/script/descriptor.cpp, changing descriptor sanity validation for Tapscript Miniscript descriptors used in wallet descriptor management.
categories.rationale: Prevents third parties from malleating Tapscript transactions by ensuring Miniscript sanity checks detect duplicate keys sharing an x-coordinate. Under BIP-379, 'malleability analysis relies on the invariant that no public key is repeated', and prior to this fix, keys differing only by parity prefix passed sanity checks despite serializing identically in Tapscript.
